articles.title: Iran says US strike killed four at wedding in 'war crime' as US denies targeting civilians
articles.description: Iranian media reports two children were among those killed when shrapnel hit a home. Iran then launched missiles and drones at US targets in the Middle East.

articles.title: Iranian attack on Saudi tanker killed two Filipino sailors, Saudi Arabia says
articles.description: The kingdom condemns the targeting of Sidr, which was reportedly hit by unknown projectiles in the Strait of Hormuz on Monday.

articles.title: EU and Nato vow to step up pressure on Russia after 'new escalation' in Germany
articles.description: Russia is accused of growing increasingly reckless after Berlin blamed Russia for a failed drone attack on Leipzig airport.

articles.title: More than 900 killed in Gaza this year despite ceasefire, Hamas-run health ministry says
articles.description: The ministry says the total number of people killed in the Strip since 10 October is now more than 1,300, including 301 children.

articles.title: What we know about reported strike on Iran wedding celebrations
articles.description: BBC Verify looks at footage showing the aftermath of a strike on a building in southern Iran.

articles.title: Attempted drone attack at German airport blamed on Russia
articles.description: Germany has blamed Russia for an attempted attack using an explosive-laden drone at Leipzig airport last month.
